dedupe_keys.name: altdss dss c api dss extensions

description: AltDSS, also called DSS C-API, is an alternative implementation of EPRI's OpenDSS distribution system simulator exposed as a library with a plain C interface. It exposes the OpenDSS and OpenDSS-PM version 9 and later engine, reproduces most of the COM interface methods of the original plus many extensions, and underpins the DSS-Extensions projects, such as the DSS-Python package, that make OpenDSS usable on Windows, Linux and macOS across x86, x86-64, ARM32 and ARM64 architectures, including Apple M1 and M2. It is developed by Paulo Meira and the DSS-Extensions contributors, with a Portuguese translation of its README. The engine is location-independent and runs any feeder model written as OpenDSS scripts. The C library is on GitHub and the Python bindings are on PyPI (DSS-Python 0.15.7, February 2026), under the BSD 3-Clause licence at no cost. Caveats: much of the code was first derived from the COM implementation, so behaviour follows OpenDSS but is not EPRI's official release, and the project's FAQ gives notes on differences that users should read; the C library repository itself shows no commit after July 2024 in the Software Heritage archive. Simulation uses are network flow analysis of distribution feeders, hosting capacity planning and resilience studies. Related records: it is an alternative engine for platform-opendss.
name: AltDSS / DSS C-API (DSS-Extensions)
